collection.title: Volkswagen Golf Hatchback 2013 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Hatchback 2013 - 2019 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Golf Hatchback, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
